featured.description:
If you are like me and have had to deal with Acid Reflux, GERD or IBS, you know its a hassle trying to figure out which foods you can eat and which cause problems. 

To make it easier for all of us fighting this battle we have created https://foodguides.com/ 

Its still obviously in development, but give us your feedback on content, products and style 

Thanks !
